tool.name: Biomni: Enumerate Bacterial Cfu By Serial Dilution
tool.description: Quantify bacterial concentration (CFU/mL) using serial dilutions and spot plating.
tool.command:
python -c " import sys import json from biomni.tool.microbiology import enumerate_bacterial_cfu_by_serial_dilution
# Parse arguments args = {} i = 1 while i < len(sys.argv): if sys.argv[i].startswith('--'): key = sys.argv[i][2:] if i + 1 < len(sys.argv) and not sys.argv[i + 1].startswith('--'): val = sys.argv[i + 1] # Type conversion if val.lower() == 'true': val = True elif val.lower() == 'false': val = False else: try: val = int(val) except: try: val = float(val) except: pass args[key] = val i += 2 else: args[key] = True i += 1 else: i += 1
# Call function result = enumerate_bacterial_cfu_by_serial_dilution(**args)
# Write output output_path = args.get('output', '/dev/stdout') with open(output_path, 'w') as f: if isinstance(result, str): f.write(result) elif isinstance(result, (dict, list)): json.dump(result, f, indent=2, default=str) else: f.write(str(result)) " --output '$output' #if $initial_sample_volume_ml --initial_sample_volume_ml '$initial_sample_volume_ml' #end if #if $estimated_concentration --estimated_concentration '$estimated_concentration' #end if #if $dilution_factor --dilution_factor '$dilution_factor' #end if #if $num_dilutions --num_dilutions '$num_dilutions' #end if #if $spots_per_dilution --spots_per_dilution '$spots_per_dilution' #end if #if $output_file --output_file '$output_file' #end if

param.name: initial_sample_volume_ml
param.label: Initial Sample Volume Ml
param.help: Volume of the initial bacterial sample in milliliters

param.name: estimated_concentration
param.label: Estimated Concentration
param.help: Estimated concentration of bacteria in the initial sample (CFU/mL)

param.name: dilution_factor
param.label: Dilution Factor
param.help: Factor by which each dilution reduces the concentration (typically 10)

param.name: num_dilutions
param.label: Num Dilutions
param.help: Number of serial dilutions to perform

param.name: spots_per_dilution
param.label: Spots Per Dilution
param.help: Number of replicate spots to plate for each dilution

param.name: output_file
param.label: Output File
param.help: Filename to save the CFU enumeration results

tool.help:
**Biomni: Enumerate Bacterial Cfu By Serial Dilution**
Quantify bacterial concentration (CFU/mL) using serial dilutions and spot plating.
Parameters ---------- initial_sample_volume_ml : float Volume of the initial bacterial sample in milliliters estimated_concentration : float Estimated concentration of bacteria in the initial sample (CFU/mL) dilution_factor : int Factor by which each dilution reduces the concentration (typically 10) num_dilutions : int Number of serial dilutions to perform spots_per_dilution : int Number of replicate spots to plate for each dilution output_file : str Filename to save the CFU enumeration results
Returns ------- str Research log summarizing the CFU enumeration process
**Domain**: microbiology **Function**: enumerate_bacterial_cfu_by_serial_dilution
